text: The exact bytes are copied to another filesystem; the embedded manifest and its hard binding are untouched.
A thumbnail is extracted from a marked asset; the thumbnail carries no manifest of its own.
An image is edited in a C2PA tool that supersedes the original claim with a new signed manifest referencing the original as an ingredient; a validator reports a valid, bound credential.
The file is copied to another folder with the operating system's byte-faithful copy.
A transcode pipeline that is C2PA-aware migrates the manifest into the new container and re-signs it.
The image is printed and rescanned at high DPI.
A C2PA-aware CDN re-encodes to WebP and re-signs a fresh manifest binding the new rendition, recording the original as an ingredient; a validator reports a valid Content Credential with lineage.
A batch converter with no C2PA support re-encodes the JPEG and writes only pixels to the new container.
The file is losslessly rotated by a tool that recomputes and re-signs the hard binding.
The asset is embedded unchanged into a BMFF container with its manifest box intact and bytes preserved.
A C2PA-aware editor changes pixels and saves without re-signing, leaving the prior manifest attached to content it no longer describes.
A C2PA-aware editor crops the image, appends an edit assertion, and re-signs, updating the hard binding to the new pixels.
An asset is re-signed after a lossless format change by a tool that migrates the manifest and updates the hard binding to the new bytes.
A manifest references an external cloud manifest that has since been deleted, so it no longer resolves.
A full-resolution screenshot of the asset is shared — a new file sampled from the framebuffer, with no manifest.
The image bytes are unchanged, but the XMP packet carrying the manifest was removed by a metadata optimizer.
Re-encode a C2PA-signed JPEG to PNG without a claim-preserving tool.
Copy a C2PA-signed file byte-for-byte to a new path.
Strip all XMP/metadata with an EXIF cleaner.
Upload a C2PA-signed image to a platform that preserves manifests (per its C2PA support).
Screenshot a C2PA-signed image on screen.
Losslessly rotate a JPEG 90° with a C2PA-aware tool that re-signs.
Crop a signed image with a generic editor that ignores C2PA.
Embed a signed image unchanged into a PDF that carries the manifest.
Convert a signed WAV to MP3 with lossy compression, no re-sign.
Rename a signed file (no content change).
Apply an Instagram filter and re-save via the app.
Add a C2PA 'edited' action assertion via a compliant editor after cropping.
Print the image and re-scan it.
Store the signed file in a zip and extract it unchanged.
Run the image through an AI upscaler with no C2PA support.
Attach the C2PA manifest as a sidecar .c2pa alongside a stripped asset.
